title: Kernel crypto API provider (crypto2dev_kcapi.ko)
description:
Add a second provider module that wraps the Linux kernel crypto API (crypto_alloc_skcipher, crypto_alloc_ahash, crypto_alloc_aead). Algo strings map 1:1 to kernel names. No wolfCrypt dependency. No FIPS gate (kernel handles it if CONFIG_CRYPTO_FIPS). Builds unconditionally alongside crypto2dev.ko.

Algorithms to register:
- skcipher: cbc(aes), ctr(aes), xts(aes)
- hash: sha256, sha384, sha512, sha3-256
- hmac: hmac(sha256), hmac(sha384), hmac(sha512)
- cmac: cmac(aes)
- AEAD: gcm(aes)

Acceptance: crypto2dev_kcapi.ko builds, loads after crypto2dev.ko, and all 11 algos appear in CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT without wolfssl provider loaded.
close_reason: All kcapi provider files written: kcapi_provider.h, kcapi_provider.c, kcapi_skcipher.c (cbc/ctr/xts), kcapi_hash.c (sha256/384/512/sha3-256/hmac-sha256/384/512/cmac), kcapi_aead.c (gcm). Kbuild updated to build crypto2dev_kcapi.ko unconditionally.
